title: A new deployment's account is seeded from a template, not a script
description:
```gherkin
Feature: An account is seeded from a template, not a script

  Scenario: One command seeds a new account
    Given a new AWS account and a deployment repository
    When a person applies the account baseline template once, giving the prefix, repository and budget name as parameters
    Then the account has the GitHub OIDC provider, the plan, deploy, approval and service roles
    And nothing in the template names AnthusAI, anth.us or another deployment's account
    And no repository variable of any other repository is written

  Scenario: The seed is the same template the pipeline later updates
    Given a seeded account
    When the template changes in Git
    Then the pipeline updates the same stack and does not create a second one
```
